cards.ex: Living in this concrete jungle makes me miss nature.
cards.exUz: Bu tosh o'rmonda yashash menga tabiatni sog'intiradi.
cards.uzDef: Beton binolar ko'p bo'lgan shahar hududi, ko'pincha yashillik kam.

cards.ex: The new park is still on the drawing board; construction hasn't started yet.
cards.exUz: Yangi park hali chizma ustida; qurilish hali boshlanmadi.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirish jarayonida, hali amalga oshirilmagan loyiha.

cards.ex: The built environment significantly impacts our well-being.
cards.exUz: Qurilgan muhit bizning farovonligimizga sezilarli ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar tomonidan qurilgan va o'zgartirilgan atrof-muhit.

cards.ex: We need to future-proof our cities against climate change.
cards.exUz: Biz shaharlarimizni iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kelajakka moslashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi ehtiyojlarga javob beradigan qilib loyihalashtirish.

cards.ex: The new development aims to integrate seamlessly into the existing urban fabric.
cards.exUz: Yangi qurilish mavjud shahar tuzilishiga uzviy qo'shilishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning jismoniy va ijtimoiy tuzilishi.

cards.ex: The council wants to improve the streetscape by adding more trees.
cards.exUz: Kengash ko'proq daraxtlar ekib, ko'cha manzarasini yaxshilashni xohlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chaning ko'rinishi, binolar, yo'llar va ko'kalamzorlashtirish.

cards.ex: The new building should be in keeping with the historic architecture of the area.
cards.exUz: Yangi bino hududning tarixiy arxitekturasi bilan mos bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa bilan mos keladigan, o'xshash uslubda bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Community engagement is crucial for successful urban planning.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat ishtiroki muvaffaqiyatli shaharsozlik uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Loyiha haqida jamoatchilik fikrini so'rash va hisobga olish.

cards.ex: We need more breathing space in the city center.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazida ko'proq nafas olish joyiga muhtojmiz.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq joy, bo'sh joy, odamlar dam olishi mumkin bo'lgan joy.

cards.ex: The old industrial area is suffering from urban decay.
cards.exUz: Eski sanoat hududi shahar yemirilishidan aziyat chekmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning bir qismining sifati pasayishi, binolar buzilishi.

cards.ex: They're going to knock down the old factory and build apartments.
cards.exUz: Ular eski fabrikni buzib tashlab, kvartiralar qurmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Binoni butunlay buzib tashlash.

cards.ex: The park has gone to seed since the funding was cut.
cards.exUz: Park moliyalashtirish qisqargandan beri qarovsiz qoldi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibor berilmaganligi sababli yomonlashmoq, qarovsiz qolmoq.

cards.ex: The new museum is located in the heart of the city.
cards.exUz: Yangi muzey shahar markazida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Biron joyning eng muhim yoki gavjum qismida joylashgan.

cards.ex: The council is trying to regenerate the downtown area.
cards.exUz: Kengash shahar markazini qayta tiklashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yomonlashgan hududni yaxshilash, qayta tiklash.

cards.ex: This neighborhood is well-connected to the rest of the city.
cards.exUz: Bu mahalla shaharning qolgan qismi bilan yaxshi bog'langan.
cards.uzDef: Transport tizimi orqali boshqa joylarga oson ulanadigan.

cards.ex: The small park is a real urban oasis in the middle of all the buildings.
cards.exUz: Kichik park barcha binolar orasida haqiqiy shahar vohasi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar ichida odamlar dam oladigan yashil joy.

cards.ex: Traffic calming measures have made the street safer for pedestrians.
cards.exUz: Harakatni sekinlashtirish choralari ko'chani piyodalar uchun xavfsizroq qildi.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositalari harakatini sekinlashtirish choralari.

cards.ex: The goal is to create a more liveable city for everyone.
cards.exUz: Maqsad - hamma uchun yashashga yaroqli shahar yaratish.
cards.uzDef: Yashash uchun qulay sharoitlarga ega bo'lgan shahar.

cards.ex: The new street furniture has really improved the look of the area.
cards.exUz: Yangi ko'cha jihozlari hududning ko'rinishini chindan ham yaxshiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chalarga o'rnatilgan o'rindiqlar, chiroqlar va boshqa jihozlar.

cards.ex: The city council is working on a new master plan for the downtown area.
cards.exUz: Shahar kengashi shahar markazi uchun yangi bosh reja ustida ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta hududni rivojlantirish uchun keng qamrovli reja.

cards.ex: The development includes mixed-income housing to promote social diversity.
cards.exUz: Qurilish ijtimoiy xilma-xillikni rag'batlantirish uchun aralash daromadli uy-joylarni o'z ichiga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Turli daromadli odamlar uchun mo'ljallangan uy-joy.

cards.ex: The pocket park provides a welcome respite from the busy street.
cards.exUz: Kichik park gavjum ko'chadan xush kelibsiz.
cards.uzDef: Kichik shahar ichidagi park, odatda bino qurish uchun bo'sh joyda.

cards.ex: The redevelopment project aims to revitalize the waterfront area.
cards.exUz: Qayta qurish loyihasi qirg'oq hududini jonlantirishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Eski hududni yangilash va yaxshilashga qaratilgan loyiha.

cards.ex: The brownfield development will create new jobs and housing.
cards.exUz: Qarovsiz hudud qurilishi yangi ish o'rinlari va uy-joy yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Oldin sanoat hududi bo'lgan, endi qayta qurilayotgan hudud.

cards.ex: Densification can help make cities more sustainable.
cards.exUz: Zichlashtirish shaharlarni barqaror qilishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Hududdagi odamlarning zichligini oshirish.

cards.ex: Adding some flowers can really improve your home's curb appeal.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta gul qo'shish uyingizning ko'cha jozibasini sezilarli darajada oshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ko'chadan ko'rinishi qanchalik jozibali.

cards.ex: Transit-oriented development encourages people to use public transportation.
cards.exUz: Transportga yo'naltirilgan rivojlanish odamlarni jamoat transportidan foydalanishga undaydi.
cards.uzDef: Jamoat transporti yaqinida joylashgan va shu bilan bog'liq bo'lgan.

cards.ex: A well-insulated building envelope can save energy.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi izolyatsiya qilingan bino qobig'i energiyani tejaydi.
cards.uzDef: Binoning tashqi devorlari, tomi va poydevori.

cards.ex: NIMBYism often hinders the development of affordable housing.
cards.exUz: NIMBYizm ko'pincha arzon uy-joy qurilishiga to'sqinlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: "Mening orqa hovlimda emas" degan pozitsiya, odatda qurilishga qarshilik.

cards.ex: The city has a classic street grid, making it easy to navigate.
cards.exUz: Shahar klassik ko'cha to'riga ega bo'lib, unda yo'nalishni osonlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'chalar to'g'ri burchak ostida kesishgan ko'cha naqshlari.
